description: This file contains the Polymer library's core JavaScript code for web components, including class definitions, feature registration, attribute handling, and rendering status management.

classes.name: Polymer.Base
classes.description: Core base class providing lifecycle callbacks, property management, and feature extension for Polymer elements.

classes.name: Polymer.Base.DomModule
classes.description: Represents a DOM module for Polymer, handling registration and import of template modules.

methods.name: resolve
methods.description: Removes the 'unresolved' attribute from the document body to signal readiness.

methods.name: Settings
methods.description: Determines Polymer's configuration regarding shadow DOM, imports, and custom elements based on user settings and environment.

methods.name: registerCallback
methods.description: Registers lifecycle callbacks for Polymer elements.

methods.name: createdCallback
methods.description: Called when a Polymer element is created; initializes instance and features.

methods.name: attachedCallback
methods.description: Called when a Polymer element is attached to the DOM.

methods.name: detachedCallback
methods.description: Called when a Polymer element is detached from the DOM.

methods.name: attributeChangedCallback
methods.description: Handles attribute changes on Polymer elements.

methods.name: extend
methods.description: Extends a prototype with properties from an API object.

methods.name: mixin
methods.description: Mixes properties from source into target object.

methods.name: serializeValueToAttribute
methods.description: Serializes a property value to an element attribute.

methods.name: deserialize
methods.description: Converts attribute string values back to property types.

methods.name: serialize
methods.description: Serializes a property value to a string for attribute setting.
